items.question: What does Hoshii cost?
answer: Pricing is set per desk on four things: monthly volume, the number of inboxes, which systems Hoshii writes into, and what your security review needs. A thirty‑minute call on your own mail produces the number for your desk.

items.question: How are credits counted?
answer: The work is metered in credits on a monthly allowance, sized with you against an average month. Unused credits roll over rather than expiring.

items.question: What is included in every plan?
answer: Read access to your ERP, every shipped Skill, the Outlook and Gmail add‑in, and EU hosting. Writing into your ERP and a custom security review are scoped separately.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
answer: Not a self‑serve trial. Instead the first run is on your own mail, live on the call, so you see what Hoshii would post to your ERP before anything is signed.

items.question: What does it cost to start?
answer: One system and one inbox is enough to start. There is no minimum commitment and no implementation fee for the ERP systems we are already live with.
